title: Sort Pairs by Second
prompt: Implement `by_second(pairs)`: return a new vector of `std::pair<std::string,int>` sorted by the int (ascending); ties keep alphabetical order of the string.

tests.name: by value
tests.code: auto in = std::vector<std::pair<std::string,int>>{{"b",2},{"a",1}}; auto out = by_second(in); CHECK(out[0].first == std::string{"a"});

tests.name: tie alphabetical
tests.code: auto in = std::vector<std::pair<std::string,int>>{{"b",1},{"a",1}}; auto out = by_second(in); CHECK(out[0].first == std::string{"a"});
tests.hint: Equal ints: compare strings as the tiebreak (a < b).

tests.name: input unchanged
tests.code: auto in = std::vector<std::pair<std::string,int>>{{"b",2},{"a",1}}; auto out = by_second(in); CHECK(in[0].first == std::string{"b"});
tests.hint: Sort a copy — the input vector must stay as it was.
